name: Nevoota Bee
description: The Nevoota Bee was a Rothana Heavy Engineering Acclamator-class assault ship that served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 22 BBY, the vessel participated in the Battle of Muunilinst, where it served in the role of a starfighter carrier, loaded with 156 V-19 Torrent starfighters. The vessel carried Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, into battle. The Jedi-led force won the engagement, capturing the planet for the Republic.

data.name: Nevoota Bee
complement: At least 20 Low Altitude Assault Transports
